name: negative_near_miss
description: The load-bearing negative. Four beliefs on the same topic, in the same scope, with near-identical wording and matching valence — and no edges at all. A propagation rule keying on similarity, shared topic, or valence proximity rather than on the declared graph fires here. Distractors with unrelated content are easy to pass and prove little (experiment 2 methodology 3.4).
evidence_count_note: Uniform, so nothing distinguishes these beliefs from chain_deep's except the absence of edges.

beliefs.proposition: Acting without verifying tends to cause rework.
